# `edva` command-line reference

```text
edva <input.dva | module_dir> [options]
```

An input is a source file or a directory module. Normal compilation writes an
executable binary; `-ir` stops after writing LLVM IR. Imports resolve first
relative to the importing source, then from the compiler's `std/` directory. A
file module is preferred over a same-named directory module.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-r`, `--run` | Run the linked binary immediately. |
| `-ir`, `--ir-only` | Emit a `.ll` file without invoking clang. |
| `-c`, `--compile-only` | Compile to an object file (`.o`) or IR without linking. |
| `--module <name>` | Compile as an isolated module unit with `<name>::` prefix. |
| `--entry` | Designate this compilation unit as the executable entry point. |
| `-o <path>` | Set the output binary or object path. |
| `-target <triple>` | Select a target triple (e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`). |
| `-O0`, `-O1`, `-O2`, `-O3` | Set code generation optimization level (default `-O2`). |
| `-no-runtime` | Build without the runtime. |
| `-no-main` | Emit `main` with internal linkage. |
| `-shared` | Build a shared library (`.so`). |
| `-H`, `--header <h>` | Generate a C header from `#export` declarations. |
| `-repl`, `--repl` | Start the stdin-based interactive REPL. |
| `-e <code>` | Parse/evaluate an inline code string. |
| `-ast`, `--ast` | Print the program AST. |
| `-ast-tree` | Print the AST as an indented tree. |
| `-typed-ast`, `-check-types` | Elaborate, verify, and print typed AST statistics. |
| `-typed-ast-tree` | Verify and dump the elaborated typed AST tree. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show usage. |

`clang` must be available on `PATH` for modes that assemble or link. Use `-ir` when
you only need the generated LLVM IR. In the REPL, `:q` exits the session.

## Package management (`edva pkg`)

```text
edva <init|add|fetch|build|test|update|graph|vendor|cache> [dir] [options]
edva pkg <command> [dir] [options]
```

`edva pkg` manages dependencies, lockfiles, targets, and test execution for packages containing an `edva.ccl` manifest. All commands can also be invoked as top-level subcommands without the `pkg` prefix.

### Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `edva init [dir] [--name <name>]` | Initialize a new package skeleton with `edva.ccl`, `src/<name>.dva`, and `src/main.dva`. |
| `edva add <alias> [source] [dir]` | Add a dependency to `edva.ccl` and resolve the graph transactionally (`--path`, `--git`, or `--url`). |
| `edva fetch [dir]` | Resolve dependencies, fetch sources, verify content hashes, write `edva.lock.ccl`, and generate `.edva/imports.ccl`. |
| `edva build [dir]` | Fetch dependencies (if needed) and compile executable target `src/main.dva` into `./<name>`. |
| `edva test [dir]` | Fetch dependencies (if needed) and run every test target in `tests/*.dva`. |
| `edva update [alias] [dir]` | Refresh moving branch/tag pins in `edva.lock.ccl` (selectively for `alias` or globally). |
| `edva graph [dir]` / `edva tree` | Display the resolved dependency graph as an ASCII tree with source provenance. |
| `edva vendor [dir]` | Materialize external dependencies into `<root>/vendor/` and generate `vendor/vendor.ccl` for offline builds. |
| `edva cache <dir\|ls\|clean>` | Manage the LLVM IR compilation cache (`dir`: show path, `ls`: list entries, `clean`: evict cached objects). |

### Package options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--locked` | Validate against `edva.lock.ccl` without updating or mutating it. |
| `--offline` | Disallow network access; require all dependencies to be local or present in cache. |
| `--store <dir>` | Path to content-addressed package store (default: `~/.cache/edva/store/`). |
| `--cache <dir>` | Path to LLVM IR compilation cache directory (default: `~/.cache/edva/ir/`). |
| `--git <exe>` | Path to git executable (default: `git`). |
| `--name <name>` | Explicit package name overriding directory basename for `edva init`. |
| `--path <path>` | Path source for `edva add`. |
| `--rev <rev>` | Git revision/branch/tag for `edva add` (default: `master`). |
| `--url <url>` | Archive download URL for `edva add`. |
| `--hash <sha256>` | Expected SHA-256 archive checksum for `edva add`. |
